capabilities: Typeset notes with curated WeChat themes
Copy finished articles as rich text
Export HTML, long images or segmented images
Save custom themes and typesetting snapshots
disambiguation: Not a general Markdown previewer; it typesets notes specifically for WeChat Official Account articles.
extras: Free and desktop-only (Obsidian 1.7.2+); does not publish articles automatically; optional note-layout enhancements are disabled by default; installable via BRAT; remote images may be fetched from their original hosts during rendering, copying or export.
problem: Preparing WeChat Official Account articles normally means leaving Obsidian and reformatting notes in a separate editor.
summary: Typesets Markdown notes into WeChat Official Account article layouts with themes, phone-width preview, rich-text copying and image or HTML export.
